title: Daily Temperatures
description:
Given an array of integers temperatures represents the daily temperatures, return an array answer such that answer[i] is the number of days you have to wait after the ith day to get a warmer temperature. If there is no future day for which this is possible, keep answer[i] == 0 instead.
 
Example 1:
Input: temperatures = [73,74,75,71,69,72,76,73]
Output: [1,1,4,2,1,1,0,0]
Example 2:
Input: temperatures = [30,40,50,60]
Output: [1,1,1,0]
Example 3:
Input: temperatures = [30,60,90]
Output: [1,1,0]

 
Constraints:

1 <= temperatures.length <= 105
30 <= temperatures[i] <= 100

def check(candidate):
    assert candidate(temperatures = [73, 74, 75, 71, 69, 72, 76, 73]) == [1, 1, 4, 2, 1, 1, 0, 0]
    assert candidate(temperatures = [30, 40, 50, 60]) == [1, 1, 1, 0]
    assert candidate(temperatures = [30, 60, 90]) == [1, 1, 0]
    assert candidate(temperatures = [80, 79, 78]) == [0, 0, 0]
    assert candidate(temperatures = [70, 70, 70]) == [0, 0, 0]
    assert candidate(temperatures = [70, 70, 71]) == [2, 1, 0]
    assert candidate(temperatures = [70, 69, 68, 71]) == [3, 2, 1, 0]
    assert candidate(temperatures = [65, 66, 65, 64, 70]) == [1, 3, 2, 1, 0]
    assert candidate(temperatures = [90, 80, 70, 60, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90]) == [0, 7, 5, 3, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0]
    assert candidate(temperatures = [60, 62, 61, 70, 69, 75]) == [1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 0]
